subject.title: [Feature] Prune stale orphaned sessions from Dashboard Sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a cross-channel Dashboard orphan-session prune flow, and what reachability, retention, default age, and auto-prune policy should it enforce?
rationale: The requested behavior is destructive and crosses Dashboard, session state, Discord, Telegram, and configuration defaults, so source inspection can show the gap but cannot safely choose the product policy.

options.title: Preview-first cross-channel prune
options.body: Add a Dashboard candidate preview/apply flow backed by plugin-owned reachability checks, revalidation before deletion, and explicit retention/default-age policy.

options.title: Narrow Discord first
options.body: Use the related Discord-only cleanup issue as the first scoped design and defer Telegram/topic pruning until the ownership contract is clearer.

options.title: Keep explicit deletion only
options.body: Leave selected-row deletion as the supported cleanup path and document that automatic orphan pruning is not currently a core behavior.

recommendation.title: Preview-first cross-channel prune
recommendation.body: Add a Dashboard candidate preview/apply flow backed by plugin-owned reachability checks, revalidation before deletion, and explicit retention/default-age policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Dashboard Sessions and session maintenance paths route most directly through recent steipete-authored history.
